prepare_parser: build an argparse parser with all BigGAN training, model, optimizer, and logging configuration arguments
save_and_load_weights: save and load generator and discriminator model weights, optimizers, and EMA state dicts to disk
ema_update: create an exponential moving average wrapper for a model and update target weights with a configurable decay rate
adam16_optimizer: build a mixed precision Adam optimizer that keeps fp32 parameter copies while doing fp16 forward and backward passes
ortho_regularization: apply modified orthogonality regularization to a PyTorch model by directly computing and adding gradients to parameters
